# ALL SCENARIOS
## Flood scenarios Travel Time All
```{r}
# Load all .img files in the specified folder
# Define the base directory
base_dir <- here("AccessMod/Output/Flood_all")

# Find all MLC_* directories
mlc_dirs <- list.dirs(path = base_dir, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)

# Initialize an empty named list to store file paths and scenario names
scenario_img_files <- list()

# Loop through each MLC_* folder and find .img files in the specific subfolder
for (mlc_dir in mlc_dirs) {
  # Extract the scenario name from the folder name
  scenario_name <- basename(mlc_dir)
  
  # Define the path to the raster_travel_time_Floods_all_config folder
  raster_dir <- file.path(mlc_dir, "0-min/raster_travel_time_Floods_all_config")
  
  # Check if the raster folder exists
  if (dir.exists(raster_dir)) {
    # Get .img files in the folder
    img_files <- list.files(path = raster_dir, pattern = "\\.img$", full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
    
    # Add the files to the list, using the scenario name as the key
    if (length(img_files) > 0) {
      scenario_img_files[[scenario_name]] <- img_files
    }
  }
}

# Print all scenarios with their respective .img files
if (length(scenario_img_files) > 0) {
  cat("Travel time scenarios and their .img files:\n")
  print(scenario_img_files)
} else {
  cat("No .img files found in any raster_travel_time_Floods_all_config folder.\n")
}

# Load all rasters
x <- lapply(scenario_img_files, function(img_files) {
  lapply(img_files, rast)
})

# Create meaningful names for each raster
x_names <- c(
    "flood_tt_all_100_10800", "flood_tt_all_100_21600", "flood_tt_all_100_3600",
    "flood_tt_all_20_10800", "flood_tt_all_20_21600", "flood_tt_all_20_3600",
    "flood_tt_all_40_10800", "flood_tt_all_40_21600", "flood_tt_all_40_3600",
    "flood_tt_all_60_10800", "flood_tt_all_60_21600", "flood_tt_all_60_3600",
    "flood_tt_all_80_10800", "flood_tt_all_80_21600", "flood_tt_all_80_3600"
)

# Assign names to the list
names(x) <- x_names

# Extract the SpatRaster from each list element
x_extracted <- lapply(x, function(obj) obj[[1]])

# Unlist the raster list into the global environment
list2env(x_extracted, envir = .GlobalEnv)

# Remove redundant objects from the environment
rm(list = setdiff(ls(), c("x", "flood_tt_all_100_10800", "flood_tt_all_100_21600", "flood_tt_all_100_3600", "flood_tt_all_20_10800", "flood_tt_all_20_21600", "flood_tt_all_20_3600", "flood_tt_all_40_10800", "flood_tt_all_40_21600", "flood_tt_all_40_3600", "flood_tt_all_60_10800", "flood_tt_all_60_21600", "flood_tt_all_60_3600", "flood_tt_all_80_10800", "flood_tt_all_80_21600", "flood_tt_all_80_3600")))
```

## Plotting the travel time rasters
```{r}
# Combine the list of SpatRasters into a single SpatRaster stack
# Extract the SpatRaster objects from the nested lists
raster_list <- lapply(x, function(obj) obj[[1]])

# Combine the extracted SpatRasters into a single SpatRaster stack
stacked_rasters <- rast(raster_list)

# Define the color scheme for the panel
color_scheme <- rev(colorRampPalette(viridis(8))(8))

# Define the color breaks
color_data <- data.frame(
    from = c(0, 15, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120, 180),
    to = c(15, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120, 180, Inf),
    color = color_scheme
)

# Create the panel grid plot
gridplot <- terra::panel(
    stacked_rasters,
    col = color_data,
    nr = 5, nc = 3, # Adjust rows and columns as needed
    axes = FALSE
)

# Display the panel grid
print(gridplot)

# [OPTIONAL] Save the gridplot as a pdf
    # png(here("Figures/flood_tt_all_scenarios.png"), width = 40, height = 60, units = "cm", res = 1000)
    # print(gridplot)
    # dev.off()
```

```{r}
save_delta_rasters <- function(raster_data, folder_name = "processed/delta_travel") {
    # Define the directory inside Data/processed
    processed_dir <- here("Data", folder_name)
    
    # Create directory if it doesn't exist
    if (!dir.exists(processed_dir)) {
        dir.create(processed_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    }
    
    # Debug: Print paths
    message("Saving rasters to: ", processed_dir)
    
    # Handle different raster structures
    if (inherits(raster_data, "SpatRaster")) {
        # If it's a multilayer raster, save as one file
        file_name <- deparse(substitute(raster_data))
        writeRaster(raster_data, filename = file.path(processed_dir, paste0(file_name, ".tif")), overwrite = TRUE)
    } else if (inherits(raster_data, "list") && inherits(raster_data[[1]], "SpatRaster")) {
        # If it's a list of SpatRasters, save separately
        for (i in seq_along(raster_data)) {
            file_path <- file.path(processed_dir, paste0(names(raster_data)[i], ".tif"))
            message("Saving: ", file_path)  # Debugging
            writeRaster(raster_data[[i]], filename = file_path, overwrite = TRUE)
        }
    } else {
        stop("Input must be a SpatRaster or a list of SpatRasters")
    }

    message("All rasters saved successfully.")
}

# Call the function
save_delta_rasters(x_delta_all, "processed/delta_travel")
```

## Plotting the delta travel time rasters
```{r}
gridplot_delta_tt <- panel(x_delta_all,
    col = data.frame(
        from = c(-Inf, -180, -120, -90, -60, -45, -30, -15, -0.01),  # Negative time differences
        to = c(-180, -120, -90, -60, -45, -30, -15, -1, 0),          # Matching the color breaks
        color = rev(colorRampPalette(turbo(9))(9))                   # Matching the turbo color palette
    ),
    nr = 5, nc = 3,            # Define number of rows and columns
    axes = FALSE,              # Hide the axes for a cleaner grid
    box = TRUE,                # Add box around each plot for clarity
    grid = TRUE,               # Draw gridlines to distinguish between plots
    main = names(x_delta_all),      # Add titles to each plot
    loc.main = "bottom",          # Position the titles at the top of each plot
)

# Add a custom legend with a title
legend("topright", legend = c("-180 to -120", "-120 to -90", "..."),
       fill = rev(colorRampPalette(turbo(9))(9)), 
       title = "Time Difference (mins)")

# Add a main title to the grid plot
mtext("Delta Travel Time Accessibility Analysis for\n All Public/PFNP Facilities under different Flooding Scenarios", side = 3, line = 3, cex = 1.5)

# Plot using ggplot2's autoplot() method from tidyterra
gridplot_delta_tt = autoplot(x_delta_all, nrow = 5, ncol = 3) +
    scale_fill_stepsn(
        colours = rev(colorRampPalette(turbo(9))(9)),  # Reversed turbo color palette with 9 steps
        name = "Delta Travel Time\nCategories (walking)",  # Improved legend title
        breaks = c(-180, -120, -90, -60, -45, -30, -15, 0),  # Custom breaks
        labels = c(">-180 min", "-180 to -120 min", "-120 to -90 min", 
                   "-90 to -60 min", "-60 to -45 min", "-45 to -30 min", 
                   "-30 to -15 min", "-15 to 0 min"),  # Legend labels
        na.value = "transparent",  # Hide NAs by making them transparent
        limits = c(-180, 0),  # Explicitly set limits to match breaks
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
        legend.position = "right",  # Move the legend to the bottom
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),  # Increase legend title font size
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),  # Increase legend label font size
        legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm"),  # Adjust width of legend keys
        legend.key.height = unit(0.5, "cm"),  # Adjust height of legend keys
        legend.spacing.x = unit(1.5, 'cm'),  # Increase spacing between legend items
        axis.text = element_blank(),  # Remove axis text
        axis.title = element_blank(),  # Remove axis titles
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray80", size = 0.5),  # Add major gridlines
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.25),  # Add minor gridlines
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white")  # Add white background to facet labels
    ) +
    guides(
        fill = guide_coloursteps(title.position = "top", nrow = 3, byrow = FALSE)  # Use guide_coloursteps for binned scales
    ) +
    ggtitle("Delta Travel Time Accessibility Analysis for All Public/PFNP Facilities under different Flooding Scenarios")


# [OPTIONAL] save the gridplot as a png
   # png(here("Figures/delta_tt_all_scenarios.png"), width = 40, height = 60, units = "cm", res = 1000)
   # print(gridplot_delta_tt)
   # dev.off()

# Selected scenarios only (20mm x 6 hours and 100 mm x 1hour)
x_selected <- c(delta_tt_all_20_21600, delta_tt_all_100_3600)

names(x_selected) <- c("20mm / 6hr", "100mm / 1hr")

# Plot using ggplot2's autoplot() method from tidyterra
autoplot(x_selected, nrow = 1, ncol = 2) +
    scale_fill_stepsn(
        colours = rev(viridisLite::turbo(8)),  # Use the turbo color palette with 8 steps
        name = "Delta Travel Time Categories (walking)",  # Improved legend title
        breaks = c(0, -15, -30, -45, -60, -90, -120, -180),  # Custom breaks in reversed order
        labels = c("-0-15 min", "-15-30 min", "-30-45 min", "-45-60 min", 
                             "-60-90 min", "-90-120 min", "-120-180 min", ">-180 min"),  # Custom legend labels in reversed order
        na.value = "transparent"  # Hide NAs by making them transparent
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",  # Move the legend to the bottom
        legend.title = element_text(size = 30),  # Increase legend title font size
        legend.text = element_text(size = 30),  # Increase legend label font size
        legend.key.width = unit(2, "cm"),  # Adjust width of legend keys
        legend.key.height = unit(1, "cm"),  # Adjust height of legend keys
        legend.spacing.x = unit(2, 'cm'),  # Increase spacing between legend items to avoid overlap
        axis.text = element_blank(),  # Remove axis text
        axis.title = element_blank(),  # Remove axis titles
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray80", size = 0.5),  # Add major gridlines
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.25),  # Add minor gridlines
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),  # Add white background to facet labels
        plot.title = element_text(size = 35),  # Increase plot title font size
        strip.text = element_text(size = 32)  # Increase the size of the scenario names
        ) +
        guides(
        fill = guide_legend(title.position = "top", nrow = 4, ncol = 2, byrow = FALSE),  # Move legend title to top and arrange items in 2 columns
        ) +
    ggtitle(" Delta Travel Time Accessibility")
```

```{r}
names(x_delta_hosp) <- c("20mm / 1hr", "20mm / 3hr", "20mm / 6hr", "40mm / 1hr", "40mm / 3hr", "40mm / 6hr", "60mm / 1hr", "60mm / 3hr", "60mm / 6hr", "80mm / 1hr", "80mm / 3hr", "80mm / 6hr", "100mm / 1hr", "100mm / 3hr", "100mm x 6hr")

# Save the delta travel time rasters for hospitals only
save_delta_rasters(x_delta_hosp, "processed/delta_travel")
```

## Plotting the delta travel time rasters
```{r}
# Plot using ggplot2's autoplot() method from tidyterra
gridplot_delta_tt_hosp = autoplot(x_delta_hosp, nrow = 5, ncol = 3) +
    scale_fill_stepsn(
        colours = rev(colorRampPalette(turbo(9))(9)),  # Reversed turbo color palette with 9 steps
        name = "Delta Travel Time\nCategories (walking)",  # Improved legend title
        breaks = c(-180, -120, -90, -60, -45, -30, -15, 0),  # Custom breaks
        labels = c(">-180 min", "-180 to -120 min", "-120 to -90 min", 
                   "-90 to -60 min", "-60 to -45 min", "-45 to -30 min", 
                   "-30 to -15 min", "-15 to 0 min"),  # Legend labels
        na.value = "transparent",  # Hide NAs by making them transparent
        limits = c(-180, 0),  # Explicitly set limits to match breaks
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
        legend.position = "right",  # Move the legend to the right
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),  # Increase legend title font size
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),  # Increase legend label font size
        legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm"),  # Adjust width of legend keys
        legend.key.height = unit(0.5, "cm"),  # Adjust height of legend keys
        legend.spacing.x = unit(1.5, 'cm'),  # Increase spacing between legend items
        axis.text = element_blank(),  # Remove axis text
        axis.title = element_blank(),  # Remove axis titles
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray80", size = 0.5),  # Add major gridlines
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.25),  # Add minor gridlines
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white")  # Add white background to facet labels
    ) +
    guides(
        fill = guide_coloursteps(title.position = "top", nrow = 3, byrow = FALSE)  # Use guide_coloursteps for binned scales
    ) +
    ggtitle("Delta Travel Time Accessibility Analysis for Public/PNFP Hospitals under different Flooding Scenarios")
```
